articles.summary: Atlanta homebuilder recognized for community development, home design, marketing, sales leadership and community service The Providence Group, a subsidiary of Green Brick Partners, Inc. (NYSE: GRBK), received multiple honors at the Greater Atlanta Home Builders Association’s 2026 OBIE Awards, including the Gold OBIE for Master-Planned Community of the Year for Waterside in Peachtree Corners. Presented October 24, the awards recognize excellence in new-home construction, community development, sales and marketing throughout Metro Atlanta. The Providence Group was honored across community planning, home design, branding, sales leadership, design leadership, and community service. “We are proud to see our team’s work recognized across so many disciplines,” said Dusty Talbert, Director of Marketing for The Providence Group. “These honors reflect the care our teams bring to creating exceptional homes, thoughtfully planned communities and meaningful experiences for our homeowners and
articles.title: The Providence Group Earns Multiple 2026 OBIE Awards, Including Master-Planned Community of the Year
